column1: # Reference-model scatter: scoped range permission and owned/reference source attribution.
# Fields: fixture, record-kind (manifest/raw/table), then the original line.
# slot-* retains the intermediate sequential-input-map comparison; range-* restores the input range map on every arm.
# Keep while the compute-model investigation cites these measurements. No daily gate consumes this file.

column3: hardware: Apple M1 Pro; 8 physical and logical CPUs; unpinned interactive Darwin arm64 workstation
environment: host-locked bounded commands; no concurrent guarded build or suite; background applications remain active
compiler_sources: b6aef58797bf83b7f44b1541443cfa2838445a44; compiler implementation unchanged through ebd3e4b7
range_owned_adaptation: Replace write_chunk with the range-reference definition and each destination with block..block+1, as on the reference arm.
intermediate_arms: Swap the entire tally definition and the section from let low_total through just before invariant full_low_bound between endpoint sources.
wf_flags: -std=c11 -pthread -O2 -Wno-override-module; --par and --no-overlap emissions; no observer in timing images
native_flags: compute-bench Makefile -O3 -g -pthread -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off -fno-vectorize -fno-slp-vectorize -fno-lto; no arm64 target override
oneTBB: 3046c8b0c29df995980003ea24f4d78c80ec0c8d; cached shared Release C++17, IPO/hwloc/malloc/upstream-tests off
link: Same Makefile object order and byte-identical harness/native/runtime objects within each session; only WF par and seq objects differ across source arms.
schedule: 5 alternating passes; 1 verified warm-up + 5 verified warm calls/process; widths 1,2,4,8; zero inter-call gap
reduction: Median of five warm samples per pass, then median of within-pass ratios; displayed wall/CPU are medians of per-pass medians.
null_rule: Paired identical reference images must remain within 3% wall per grid/width; slot-small/W4 and range-small/W4,W8 are inconclusive.
native_comparison: TBB chain keeps block/padded-stream decomposition but has a different helper/budget realization; TBB direct changes the algorithm and storage.
